title: 1-8 products: the product page carries the story
when: A small range where each product needs explaining.

steps.note: Up to 12 photos including infographics; a short silent product video first (`images.order: first`). Hide advantages until the merchant confirms policies.
What it is made of or how it works, from the merchant.
All formats of the range; no similar-products shelf under 8 products.

The store-wide subscription keeps the preset chosen on home: `section set` restyles it on every page. Only where it already sits on this page: `section add` makes an independent copy, not the shared one.

notes: Ask the merchant for infographic photos and a product video rather than adding explanatory sections.

Before publishing, preview the product page: no «we do not deliver to this city» line (else `pdp-modules-prelaunch`), advantages only confirmed policies, no technical names in the chips. See references/product-page.md.
